sections.title: Player text
sections.body: The Custodian unfolds her home like a blossoming flower and draws the crate inside, sealing it open again as a workshop. She breaks the seal. Inside lies a massive stone carved with a lion's face. She goes still, then nods, slow and grave. "Of course Emeris would keep this delivery quiet," she says. "This is the Keystone Asset: the heart-stone for Hush's failing ward. If the route knew what you carried, every hungry thing in the preserve would follow the scent of it." The light in her home dims as she speaks. "We must take it to the Open Vale and revitalize the ward before Hush has to trust paper promises instead of protection. That much magic will draw dangerous things from the deep preserve. I will need your help."

Gmprivate: If package_status=lost, stop the normal reveal and use only the Kyle-confirmed recovery branch when it exists. The deepest truth is that the ward protects by consuming. In Act 4 this remains a seed, never a full explanation. Calibrate her candor to custodian_trust and ward_awareness.
Playertakeaway: The job was never small, and now you know why: you are being asked to finish it at real risk.
Storytakeaway: The package was the heart-stone for Hush's failing ward, and renewing it will draw danger from the deep preserve.
Mechanictakeaway: The reveal writes keystone_understanding: surface from hearing her, deep from Knowledge 14 or hard questions with high trust.
